start: Profile, a finished workout with two exercises, a note and one new record

steps.action: Tap the workout in the Profile feed
user_sees: The workout's name as the page title, then the day and the time it started
Stats row: Time, Kg lifted, Sets, Records
The workout's note under the stats
must_not: Another workout's sets or note
A stat shown as NaN or blank

steps.action: Scroll to Muscle split and the exercises
user_sees: Header 'Muscle split' with a bar per muscle and a number that says 'sets'
Each exercise card with its picture, name, and a 'Set · Weight & reps' table: W for warm-up, 1, 2 for working sets, '@8' where effort was rated
must_not: A bare number beside a muscle with no 'sets'
Warm-up sets counted in the muscle split

steps.action: Look at the exercise that set a record
user_sees: A badge under the exercise naming the record and its value
A medal on the set that holds it
must_not: The record named twice when the lift is two cards (heavy and back-off)
A medal on a set that does not hold a record

steps.action: Tap the exercise name
user_sees: The exercise's own page opens, once
must_not: Two exercise pages stacked after a fast double tap

start: An exercise page whose exercise was done in a saved workout

steps.action: Open the exercise page and look at its 'Last time' card
user_sees: The same set table as on the saved workout page: 'Set' and the exercise's own head such as 'Weight & reps' or 'Time'
W / 1 / 2 marks and '@8' where effort was rated
must_not: Different numbers for the same sets than on the workout's page
A 'Weight & reps' head on a time-only exercise

start: A link to a workout that was deleted, and a workout whose read fails

steps.action: Open the workout page of a deleted workout
user_sees: 'Workout not found' with 'This workout may have been deleted.'
must_not: An endless loading skeleton
The Share and More buttons shown with nothing to act on

steps.action: Open a workout while the phone's database read fails
user_sees: A load error for 'this workout' with Try again
must_not: 'Workout not found' when the workout exists
A blank page

steps.action: Rename the workout while the save fails
user_sees: Message 'Could not rename' with 'The workout keeps its name. Try again.'
must_not: The new name shown as saved
No message at all

steps.action: Tap More, then 'Rename workout', type a new name, tap 'Save name'
user_sees: The page title changes to the new name
must_not: The old name still on the page after the save

steps.action: Tap More, then 'Delete workout', and confirm
user_sees: The page closes back to the screen before (or to Profile)
must_not: The workout deleted without being asked first
The deleted workout still in the Profile feed

steps.action: Open the same workout again from a stale link
user_sees: 'Workout not found'
must_not: The deleted workout's sets shown again

steps.action: Look at what the page shows
user_sees: Only this member's own workout from this phone: sets, note, body-weight hint 'Log your body weight so pull-ups and dips count in your ...'
must_not: Another member's workout
The member's body weight number printed on the page

steps.action: Tap Share, then 'Share as text'
user_sees: The phone's own share sheet with the workout as text; nothing is sent until the member picks an app
must_not: The workout sent anywhere before the member picks where
The workout's private note added to the share without the member seeing it
